tools.name: scenef_discounts
tools.description: Every structured discount across one board's theaters — venue, label, detail, and day-bound days — with the ones that apply today flagged. Membership and discount-card pricing is not listed; it reads "Member pricing; see the theater". Read-only: the call itself records nothing.

tools.description: Lists films whose first screening on this board is more than 48 hours out, sorted by first night. Configurable horizon. It sets no alert, watch or reminder.
